method: Manual visual pixel-landmark estimates on four original 848x1264 PNGs and the user-supplied 896x1200 replacement orange PNG. Body height is y of lowest physical base minus y of topmost plastic rim, excluding cream. Rim width is the outer horizontal rim span; base width is the horizontal span across the lowest molded foot near its widest visible section. Ratios are projected image geometry, not physical dimensions. Approximate landmark uncertainty is 8 pixels per coordinate; lower transparent edges are especially ambiguous. No image has been geometrically rectified.

measurements.note: Rounded broad base; rim ellipse relatively deep.
Narrow stepped amber foot; rectangular base corners.
Broad nearly flat rim, dark stepped foot; shortest body per rim width.
User-supplied upright replacement; broad near-horizontal rim, smooth taper and simple flat base. Old leaned-back source is superseded.
